slides.title: From BHAG to sprint lanes
slides.headline: From your BHAG to this week’s work.

artwork.alt: A cascade of five levels. BHAG, Big Hairy Audacious Goal, 10 to 30 years. 3HAG, 3 Year Highly Achievable Goal, 3 years. 1HAG, 1 Year Highly Achievable Goal, this year. QHAG, Quarterly Highly Achievable Goal, this quarter. Sprint Lanes, 13-Week Sprint Lanes, week by week. Each level is built from the one above it and directs the one below.

notes: Where we are: the KFFM shows how the business makes money. The plan says where to take it.
The next slides take each level in turn, from the BHAG to the sprint lanes. Every level from the 3HAG down counts the KFFM widgets.

slides.title: 3HAG: 3 Year Highly Achievable Goal
slides.headline: 3HAG: 3 Year Highly Achievable Goal
slides.support: A three-year stepping stone toward the BHAG.
body: Connect the future company to the capabilities and targets needed to get there.

artwork.alt: The cascade from BHAG to sprint lanes: BHAG, 3HAG, 1HAG, QHAG, then 13-week sprint lanes. 3HAG is highlighted: this is where we are.

notes: Where we are: the 3HAG. The next slide shows what it holds.

slides.title: 1HAG: 1 Year Highly Achievable Goal
slides.headline: 1HAG: 1 Year Highly Achievable Goal
body: Set this year’s targets and the few priorities that move the 3HAG forward.

artwork.alt: The cascade from BHAG to sprint lanes: BHAG, 3HAG, 1HAG, QHAG, then 13-week sprint lanes. 1HAG is highlighted: this is where we are.

notes: Where we are: the 1HAG. Every number and priority comes from the 3HAG above it.

slides.title: QHAG: Quarterly Highly Achievable Goal
slides.headline: QHAG: Quarterly Highly Achievable Goal
body: Set this quarter’s targets, month by month, and the priorities that deliver the 1HAG.

artwork.alt: The cascade from BHAG to sprint lanes: BHAG, 3HAG, 1HAG, QHAG, then 13-week sprint lanes. QHAG is highlighted: this is where we are.

notes: Where we are: the QHAG. The sprint lanes come next.

slides.title: 13-Week Sprint Lanes
slides.headline: 13-Week Sprint Lanes
slides.support: The weekly steps that deliver the QHAG.
body: Plan each quarterly priority week by week, with a weekly widget forecast.

artwork.alt: The cascade from BHAG to sprint lanes: BHAG, 3HAG, 1HAG, QHAG, then 13-week sprint lanes. Sprint lanes is highlighted: this is where we are.

notes: Where we are: the sprint lanes, the last level of the cascade. Every week traces back to the BHAG.

slides.title: What a sprint lane holds
slides.headline: What a sprint lane holds.

panels.heading: One lane for each quarterly priority
panels.support: Each lane has the same owner as its priority.

panels.heading: One step each week
panels.support: The step that week that moves the priority toward its measure of success.

panels.heading: A widget forecast, week by week
panels.support: The weekly forecast adds up to the quarter’s widget targets.

notes: Update the lanes every week. Red means needs attention. A red week is a prompt to act.
The lanes are on the Mural board, under each QHAG.

slides.title: Present your plan
slides.headline: Present your plan in 12 minutes.

panels.heading: Walk your plan
panels.support: From your column on the Mural board, BHAG to sprint lanes. Say which numbers are on track.

panels.heading: Convince us
panels.support: Why is this going to work?

panels.heading: Finish with your team
panels.support: How will you present this plan to your company and get everyone on side?

notes: 1:50 to 3:50 PM. Five slots of 24 minutes: 12 to present, 12 for feedback. No break.
The coach skips a member who is not prepared. That member stays and gives feedback.
Open the board from the Mural invite. The board link stays off the slides, because the deck is public.

slides.title: Feedback
slides.headline: Then 12 minutes of feedback.

panels.heading: First, check the plan
panels.support: The group checks it against these 5 points.
items: Every row on the board has a number and one owner.
Ideally 3, up to 5 priorities, ranked, number one first.
Each 1HAG priority builds a 3HAG key capability. Each QHAG priority advances a 1HAG priority.
The widget targets support the revenue.
The 13-week sprint lanes and weekly widget forecast reach the quarter’s priorities and widget targets.

panels.heading: Then give feedback
items: Group: experience shares. Use “I” and “did”, not “you” and “should”.
Presenter: name the one thing you will change in your plan.

notes: Experience shares come from your own experience. They are not advice.
Coach: test each member’s number one priority with the four questions.
The presenter closes the slot by naming one change to their plan.
Leave this up while each member presents.
